Chapter 234: Chapter 21: Starting The Fifth Shuttle (End Of This Volume, Please Subscribe)_2

Chapter 234: Chapter 21: Starting the Fifth Shuttle (End of This Volume, Please Subscribe)_2

Even without killing an alien strong one, one can still obtain the corresponding merit points.

“It’s too dangerous,”

Lin Yuan slightly shook his head.

On the battlefields of different races, earning merit points sounds easy.

Killing a sixth rank alien strong one can earn you a thousand points.

But in reality, a sixth rank alien won’t just wait for you to kill them.

...

It requires evolvers to risk their lives.

A sixth rank evolver, wanting to kill a sixth rank alien strong one,

really needs to pay a great price, and that alien strong one isn’t a fool either; if they know they are outmatched, they will flee.

Defeating a sixth rank alien is easy.

Killing them is difficult.

And alien strong ones often do not come alone.

But in clusters.

In such situations, killing them is really difficult.

It is the same with all sixth rank aliens.

Not to mention the seventh and eighth ranks.

Thousands of years ago, the Chikun Star Lord, enraged by the assassination of a disciple,

went on a killing spree on the alien battlefields.

But most of those he killed were aliens below the sixth rank.

Basically cannon fodder.

The truly powerful aliens had fled early.

And after a while, the Chikun Star Lord was blocked by alien strong ones of the same rank.

All the alien strong ones capable of stalemating with human civilization, close in power to the Insect Race notwithstanding, are extremely powerful.

“Upgrade to a sixth rank citizen,”

Lin Yuan thought to himself.

His citizenship rank instantly upgraded from fifth rank to sixth rank.

From fifth rank citizen to sixth rank citizen, it requires five hundred thousand merit points, which Lin Yuan had already saved by perfecting the Martial Path Evolutionary Path.

Hum.

Moments later,

Lin Yuan successfully became a sixth rank citizen.

At the same time,

An ’email’ from the Human Civilization Alliance was sent to Lin Yuan’s inbox.

The email content generally introduced some of the many privileges of a sixth rank citizen.

Most privileges of a sixth rank citizen are advanced versions of those of a fifth rank citizen.

Besides,

a sixth rank citizen, compared to a fifth rank citizen, has an additional benefit, a certain privilege.

The benefit being that upon promotion to a sixth rank citizen, one will receive a bottle of Evolution Elixir issued by Human Civilization.

Sixth Rank Evolution Elixir.

The function of this Evolution Elixir is to forcibly elevate an evolver’s physical body and soul to the sixth rank level.

Of course, only the physical body and soul are enhanced; as for the comprehension of rules and the understanding of evolutionary paths, those will not change, as they cannot be improved by external means.

This benefit exists specifically for scientists and developers who aren’t skilled in the paths of evolution.

These scientists and developers might have made significant contributions to human civilization but lack evolutionary talent, being only second or third rank evolvers.

And taking gene elixirs and the like carries the risk of death.

So, once the level of citizenship reaches the sixth rank, one can obtain the Sixth Rank Evolution Elixir.

The Sixth Rank Evolution Elixir, when taken, carries no risks, and the physical body and soul perfectly transform.

Of course, human civilization grants such a benefit to sixth rank citizens primarily to enable them to live thousands to tens of thousands more years.

To continue contributing to human civilization.

“Sixth Rank Evolution Elixir…”

Lin Yuan looked astonished; such a rare treasure that can elevate an ordinary person to the status of sixth rank evolver in one stride is obviously priceless.

At least Lin Yuan hadn’t seen such a product on the market app when he was a fifth rank citizen, clearly not having sufficient privileges.

“However, evolvers who step into the sixth rank by taking the Sixth Rank Evolution Elixir are estimated to be at the lowest end of the sixth rank combat power,”

Lin Yuan was aware.

The combat power of sixth rank evolvers is composed of multiple aspects.

One is the basic strength of a sixth rank level.

Another is mastery of the secret techniques they wield.

Third is the degree of perception of rules.

And fourth is the strength of their own cultivation evolutionary path.

Evolvers who took the Sixth Rank Evolution Elixir possess only the basic strength of the sixth rank.

…

The second privilege, or eligibility, of a sixth rank citizen is to participate in the Star Alliance Conference held once every century.

The so-called Star Alliance is an alliance formed of multiple star domains.

Currently, the Chikun Star Domain is part of the ‘Annan’ Star Alliance.

And the Star Alliance Conference is initiated by the official Annan Star Alliance, with only the sixth rank citizens and above eligible to participate.

At the Star Alliance Conference, all participating citizens can propose their suggestions.

The scale of these suggestions can vary greatly.

On a small scale, it concerns individual benefits.

For instance, a sixth rank citizen might suggest they lack a personal battleship and therefore apply to the Annan Star Alliance.

The Annan Star Alliance will most likely ‘allocate’ a battleship to this sixth rank citizen.

On a large scale, it involves altering certain laws within the Annan Star Alliance, such as a sixth rank citizen who feels that the death penalty isn’t humane and wants to abolish it.

The Annan Star Alliance will consider this suggestion and eventually respond with approval, rejection, or reservation.

Of course, the laws here solely refer to those internal to the Star Alliance.

As for the charter laws enacted by the Cosmic Human Alliance, they are beyond what a sixth rank citizen can question.

“Star Alliance Conference?”

Lin Yuan pondered.

This conference symbolizes the supreme power of a star alliance and only sixth rank citizens who have made significant contributions to human civilization are qualified to participate.

…..

After carefully reviewing the many privileges of sixth rank citizens,

Lin Yuan stood up and walked out of the palace.

“Take me to see the teacher,”

Lin Yuan glanced at the supervisor outside the palace.

“Yes,”

“Peak Master, please follow me,”

The supervisor, showing great respect, led Lin Yuan towards the largest central mountain.

…

“I’ve seen the teacher,”

Inside the crimson palace.
